title: Piercing Statue Duo #039 (쓰리쿼터 · [쓰리쿼터·P25 집중형·lapis lazuli·메이크업 EgyptianGlam] ; [쓰리쿼터·P50 정의형·wenge·메이크업 걸크러시])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, three-quarter statue portrait. TWO women standing side by side, each angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so every woman's whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the knees, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Egyptian woman — warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge rose-gold bar hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide rose-gold ear cuff, three smaller rose-gold rings, two thick rose-gold bars and a small rose-gold stud up to the top; one small rose-gold stud sits in the right ear; four rose-gold pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small rose-gold rings pass through the left nostril and a thick rose-gold septum ring hangs below the nose; a rose-gold hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a rose-gold snake-bite ring beside it and a small rose-gold ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a rose-gold Medusa stud sits above the lips; a rose-gold labret stud and a small rose-gold ring sit on the chin; three small rose-gold studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small amethysts set into the metal.
#1 Physique: A still-visible cinched waist beneath a full soft chest, wide curving hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#1 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid opaque stone, solid deep lapis lazuli, a rich royal-blue stone scattered with small glittering flecks of golden pyrite throughout, polished to a hard, cool sheen, completely opaque, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a completely opaque solid that no light passes through; her face, ears and neck are living flesh.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Korean woman — fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in low bun. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick copper septum ring with a smaller copper ring above it and two copper rings through each nostril; a straight copper bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three copper pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; a copper Medusa stud above the lips; a big copper hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a copper labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small copper studs along each jaw; a curved row of small copper studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized copper hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine copper chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings.
#2 Physique: A colossal, statuesque chest, a broad heavy torso and wide statuesque hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, all on a grand imperial scale.
#2 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid opaque wood, solid dark wenge wood, a deep near-black wood finely striped with narrow gold-tan pinstripes running through it, polished to a hard satin sheen, completely opaque, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. Right at the knee, where the leg would bend, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a completely opaque solid that no light passes through; her face, ears and neck are living flesh.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Boundary for each woman: a sharp jagged line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones — real skin above, material immediately below. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. Each rounded tip is that material's own carved finish — never the edge of a photograph. Shards interlock along the collarbone line only.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind them washed with two coloured lights from behind — a pale lilac on one side and a soft mint on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath them.

Pose: each stands tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, every hand well away from every face, heads tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods every transparent body from behind, tinting it, while the opaque bodies block it completely and are lit by two large softboxes raking from either side. A soft frontal light falls on all the faces and ears; a thin cool rim light traces every figure. Only each woman's face, ears and neck read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
